mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average return in low-FEDFUNDS periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% over a 3-month period indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.5% (3-month average), or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.5 index level signal robust consumer demand and manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST>1000 and INDPRO>100.5 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 3%), the Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 3%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.5 index level indicates robust manufacturing output, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO level fails to correlate with positive 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars indicate strong consumer spending, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS level fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falling below 135,000 thousand units signals a weakening labor market, reducing consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 135,000, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% for 6 months (6-month average) indicates an extended monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.1% (6-month average), or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
